work.name: Modular & component-driven architecture
work.description: I build interfaces using small, reusable components, following atomic design principles to create flexible and scalable systems. I place strong emphasis on clean, well-structured, and easy-to-read code, making components easy to maintain, reuse, and extend when composing larger layouts.

work.name: Design principles
work.description: With a background in architecture, I bring a strong understanding of usable, functional design. I focus on consistency, visual hierarchy, and responsive layouts, while ensuring accessibility standards are met — including compliance with current legislation — through semantic structure, clear interactions, and inclusive design practices.

work.name: CMS architecture & content management
work.description: I design and develop reusable CMS modules that power pages built from a shared template, extending and improving existing components to support new features and use cases. I also help troubleshoot and resolve CMS-related issues across teams, ensuring content remains flexible, reliable, and easy to manage.

work.name: Data models & TypeScript schemas
work.description: I design and implement robust data models and TypeScript schemas to ensure consistency across various projects and CMS modules. Using typed structures helps prevent errors, supports maintainable code, and makes it easier to scale features and integrate with different systems.

work.name: Client-side & server-side development
work.description: I develop interactive, dynamic web pages and components, handling both client-side functionality and server-side logic when needed. This includes creating reusable frontend components, integrating APIs, managing forms and workflows, and ensuring smooth communication between front-end and back-end systems.

work.name: Automation & AI-assisted workflows
work.description: I leverage automation and AI tools to streamline repetitive tasks and improve efficiency, reducing execution time and supporting faster delivery. I actively experiment with AI technologies and have participated in internal hackathons, integrating innovative solutions into daily workflows to enhance productivity.

work.name: Technical leadership & collaboration
work.description: I take ownership of technical decisions within projects, coordinate work across teams, and help shape implementation approaches. I’ve led technical interviews, supported teammates through code reviews and collaboration, and actively contribute to improving development workflows and standards.

work.name: Data-driven improvements & optimisation
work.description: I analysed user behaviour and campaign performance to inform design and development decisions. Using tools like Google Analytics and Looker, I identify opportunities for improvement, optimise interfaces, and iterate on features to increase engagement, conversions, and overall effectiveness of web projects.
